data.name: Bhadraji
data.gender_notes: Bhadraji is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhadra', it signifies someone who is blessed or auspicious. The name Bhadraji carries the meaning “Blessed or Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhadraji usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed or auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine grace and protection.
data.etymology: Bhadraji belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed or Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhadraji total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: In Hinduism, the name "Bhadraji" is revered and considered auspicious. It is a common name for deities, temples, and even people. In some regions, "Bhadraji" is the name of the Goddess Bhadrakali or Durga. In Maharashtra, India, there is a famous temple dedicated to Lord Bhadrakali, where devotees go seeking blessings for prosperity and happiness.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Bhadraji" is synonymous with blessings, prosperity, and good fortune. It is believed that those who bear this name or refer to a deity by this name will be protected, guided, and blessed with the goodness of the universe. It also signifies the inner qualities of virtuousness, kindness, and benevolence- qualities that add positivity to one's spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bhadraji: One who bestows goodness and auspiciousness upon all. Radiating positivity and prosperity, like the blessings of the goddess Bhagas.
